Fixes after the round 5 behavior audits. Linking moves no progress any more: the game asks "Link to this Steam account?" (the profile to check - "Edit Profile" if it's yours), Link/Cancel (Cancel unlinks), then "Successfully linked"/"Unlinked" in one fixed layout; a link made elsewhere (found by the quiet check, now at every start - an unlink on the site counts from the next start) opens Settings with the same question, steam.cert saved only once answered; the link page never shown on screen nor logged, good for 3 minutes. A Steam invite or steam://run link never opens a demo; while playing it never leaves a ranked match ("Cannot leave a ranked match.") and asks before leaving a hosted server or the editor. Protocol version in the handshake (major.minor - patch releases play together, another version is told so); a ranked match waiting for nobody answers "A ranked match is in progress there - only its players can rejoin." instead of silence (a player just dropped still rejoins in the same attempt). Signalling: at most 32 web peers from one address. Wrong passwords of peers without an address counted per account. Web: a WebRTC connection failed or disconnected for 5 s is a lost connection; natively 10 s of silence is noticed during downloads and arena changes too. IPv6 addresses refused with a message. Browser join link keeps the port of the WebRTC id. Community domains never saved as the last join, an IP never taken for a domain. Match reports queued per instance label. Resetting r1's settings clears its patch. Clearer "not listed" log; reselect after Refresh without Server details; the host in its players' Steam group; no event countdown from the cached list; dumped entries without official domains. local-testing: link_flow_test without progress moves, ranked_corners REJOIN_AFTER/STRANGER, web KILL_SERVER/TAB_AWAY, soak with the protocol version.
